shorts.hook: The heaviest invertebrate on Earth hid from cameras for a century.
shorts.title: Nobody Filmed a Live Colossal Squid for 100 Years
shorts.outro: Doug waved at that eye a few seconds later. The hooks noticed. What they grabbed first is in the full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT DID THE HOOKS GRAB FIRST?

shorts.title: This Shark Was Born Around the Time of the Mayflower
shorts.outro: Then Doug tried to outswim this shark, which cruises slower than you walk. It never chased him. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: HOW DID A SLOW SHARK GET DOUG?

shorts.hook: This giant deep-sea bug once refused food for five years.
shorts.title: The Giant Isopod That Didn't Eat for Five Years
shorts.outro: Four kilometers deeper, Doug meets a sea spider whose legs do its digesting. He put a stethoscope on one. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT DID DOUG HEAR IN ITS LEG?

shorts.title: The Earthquake Fish of Japan Predicts Nothing
shorts.outro: The oarfish only ignored Doug. Six kilometers deeper, he lowered a sandwich as bait. Something answered. Full video below.
